info.title: Basket Order Module
info.description: Go port of the supplied Java module. See docs/PARITY.md for source defects, sample conflicts, and integration requirements. Business failures generally use HTTP 200 and status Not ok.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Adds one scrip; maximum business.max_scrips defaults to 20. Returns all basket scrips. Exchange/token/symbol/expiry/format/week-tag are refreshed from the contract cache; add response lotSize is null.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive ID owned by the caller.
- scrips (Scrip; Required): See shared Scrip fields below. A single object, not an array.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket, Basket reached the maximum limits

basketId.description: Positive ID owned by the caller. Requirement: Required.

scrips.description: See shared Scrip fields below. A single object, not an array. Requirement: Required.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Creates the basket and returns the user’s personal basket list, newest ID first.

Request fields:
- basketName (string; Required): Nonblank; unique for the authenticated user.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Basket name already exist

basketName.description: Nonblank; unique for the authenticated user. Requirement: Required.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Deletes matching scrips and returns the remaining scrip array, which can be empty.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive owned basket ID.
- scripsId (integer[]; Required): Nonempty list of scrip IDs belonging to this basket.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket, No records found

basketId.description: Positive owned basket ID. Requirement: Required.

scripsId.description: Nonempty list of scrip IDs belonging to this basket. Requirement: Required.

delete.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Requires ownership. Deletes the basket and its scrips transactionally; related notifications are deleted when the notification module is enabled. Returns the remaining personal basket list.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Submits the request’s scrips to the configured bulk-order service, forwarding the bearer token. Does not load the saved basket scrips as the order request. A non-null upstream response marks the basket executed; individual broker rejections are not aggregated. Returns an ARRAY of response envelopes. No automatic order retry.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive owned basket ID.
- scrips (Scrip[]; Required): Nonempty submitted order list; tradingSymbol and source required per scrip.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket, Failed

basketId.description: Positive owned basket ID. Requirement: Required.

scrips.description: Nonempty submitted order list; tradingSymbol and source required per scrip. Requirement: Required.

get.description: Enabled by modules.basket. Returns basketId, basketName, isExecuted (string "0"/"1"), createdOn (epoch milliseconds), and scripCount. Research-call baskets are excluded. An empty list returns status Ok, message No records found, result null.

Enabled by modules.basket. Requires basket ownership. Returns scrips ordered by ID and refreshes lotSize from the contract cache. No scrips: status Ok, message No records found, result null.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket

post.description:
Enabled by modules.margin. Nonempty array body. Uses cached customer credentials for the configured NEST endpoint. business.legacy_nest_first_only defaults to true: only the first leg is sent. Set false to send all legs. Returns upstream spanRequirement as span. Upstream HTTP 401 propagates.

Request fields:
- exchange (string; Required per item): Exchange.
- qty (string; Required per item): Quantity sent as netQty.
- symbol (string; Supply for upstream): Trading symbol. Token, price and transType are accepted DTO fields but not forwarded by this route.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Upstream Emsg

qty.description: Quantity sent as netQty. Requirement: Required per item.

symbol.description: Trading symbol. Token, price and transType are accepted DTO fields but not forwarded by this route. Requirement: Supply for upstream.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Persists the name and returns the personal basket list.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive ID owned by the caller.
- basketName (string; Required): Nonblank, unique for the user, including the current name.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Basket name already exist, Invalid basket

basketId.description: Positive ID owned by the caller. Requirement: Required.

basketName.description: Nonblank, unique for the user, including the current name. Requirement: Required.

get.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Sets isExecuted to "0" for an owned basket and returns the personal basket list. This does not cancel broker orders.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket

post.description:
Enabled by modules.margin. The body is an array. Requires the user REST session in cache. Equity margin is qty × price / business.equity_margin_divisor (default 5). Adds derivative span_trade and expo_trade; MCX multiplies quantity by contract lot size. Returns a two-decimal span string. Derivative upstream failure preserves the equity subtotal. Missing session returns HTTP 401.

Request fields:
- exchange (string; Required per item): NSE/BSE equity is calculated locally; other exchanges use derivative span.
- token (string; Required per item): Contract token; derivatives require a contract-cache entry.
- qty (string; Required per item): Numeric quantity string.
- price (string; Required per item): Numeric price string.
- transType (string; Required per item): BUY/B or SELL/S.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter

exchange.description: NSE/BSE equity is calculated locally; other exchanges use derivative span. Requirement: Required per item.

token.description: Contract token; derivatives require a contract-cache entry. Requirement: Required per item.

qty.description: Numeric quantity string. Requirement: Required per item.

price.description: Numeric price string. Requirement: Required per item.

transType.description: BUY/B or SELL/S. Requirement: Required per item.

post.summary: Calculate equity and derivative span margin

post.description:
Enabled by modules.basket. Updates are transactional. Returns status Ok, message Success, result null. This is a full field update, not PATCH; send every required trading field. A missing scrip returns the legacy combination status Ok and message Invalid basket.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive ID owned by the caller.
- scrips (Scrip; Required): See shared Scrip fields below. Each id must identify an existing scrip in this basket.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket

post.description:
Enabled by modules.admin. Requires raw admin Authorization header plus vendor apiKey. Exchanges allowed by default: NSE, BSE, NFO, CDS. Quantities multiply by contract lot size. Marks researchIdeas cache and queues per-user basket creation. HTTP success means the campaign was queued, not that all background work succeeded. Persists notification records and sends push for eligible device-mapped users.

Request fields:
- apiKey (string; Required for authorization): Must identify a vendor with tpp_authorization = 1.
- basketName (string; Required): Nonblank; a local date/time suffix is appended.
- expiryDate (timestamp; Required): Example YYYY-MM-DD; see date conventions.
- scrips (Scrip[]; Required): Non-null array, maximum 20 by default; tradingSymbol required. Source permits an empty array.
- userId (string[]; Optional): If omitted/empty, distribute to all distinct device-mapped users.
- description (string; Optional): Basket description.
- pushNotification (integer; Optional): 1 enables notification processing if the module is enabled.
- title (string; Optional): Push title.
- message (string; Optional): Push/notification message.

Business messages: Your not a vendor, Your not authorized by admin, Invalid Parameter, Scrip is more than maximum size, Invalid Exchange, Notification queue is full

delete.description:
Enabled by modules.admin. Public by default through auth.public_paths; removing the configured exception requires JWT authentication. Deletes baskets whose expiry_date is strictly before local midnight, associated scrips and (if enabled) notifications. Not restricted to the calling user. No body.

Business messages: No records found, Failed

post.description:
Enabled by modules.cache. Authenticated maintenance operation across users. Deletes scrips with expiry strictly before local midnight; does not delete their baskets. Returns "<count>-Record Deleted"; zero is a successful result. No body.

Business messages: Failed to deleted

get.description:
Enabled by modules.research. Returns the selected active report in a one-element result array, with name, audit fields and activeStatus.

Business messages: No data found

post.description:
Enabled by modules.research. Send {} for default filters. Active calls must map to the user or ALL. Default closed-call window is business.closed_research_days (7). Explicit status removes that default age filter. Groups by category then subcategory; each call includes scripdetails. Other fields in the legacy request DTO do not add filters here.

Request fields:
- analystName (string; Optional): Trimmed analyst filter.
- status (string; Optional): Case-insensitive status filter; omitted means open calls plus recently closed calls.

Business messages: No data found for this user, No data found, Invalid Parameter

status.description: Case-insensitive status filter; omitted means open calls plus recently closed calls. Requirement: Optional.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.research. A JSON object body is required; {} is sufficient. Uses active research calls visible to the user or ALL. Groups flattened scrip entries by category/subcategory, adding basketId to each scrip. Calls without scrips are skipped. Request filter fields are not applied by this handler.

Business messages: No data found, Invalid Parameter
post.summary: Get research scrips grouped as baskets

get.description:
Enabled by modules.research. Returns distinct statuses from the research master table. This list is not restricted by user mappings or active status.

Business messages: No data found

post.description:
Enabled by modules.research. Returns report summaries in result; an empty result array is successful.

Request fields:
- basketType (string; Optional): Matches the report type column; {} returns all active reports.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter

basketType.description: Matches the report type column; {} returns all active reports. Requirement: Optional.

get.description:
Enabled by modules.research. Returns active reports with id, title, attachment, description, type, url and createdOn.

Business messages: No data found
Enabled by modules.thematic. Returns HTTP 204 with no body because the supplied Java service has no category-header implementation.

204.description: The Java service returns null; no category-header implementation was supplied.

get.description:
Enabled by modules.thematic. Returns current-source metadata, latest-version scrips and associated active documents. minInvstAmt maps to total_invst_amt. The source checks basket existence here, not catalog visibility. Response field names include subcategory, analyst, risk and minInvstAmt; see example.

Business messages: Basket not found for ID: <id>

Enabled by modules.thematic. Requires active status, action_type SEND_NOW, status Open, and a user/ALL mapping. Scrips use the latest basket version. basketId is a string here. Contract cache supplies pdc when available.

Business messages: No data found for this user

Enabled by modules.thematic. Aggregates legacy execution journals containing broker order numbers. Returns basketName, userId, investedAmount, createdDate, executedDate, string lotSize and scripList. V1 journals have a different shape and are skipped by this parser. Empty result is successful.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.thematic. Forwards bearer token and orders tagged TBK:<basketId>. Outside configured market days/hours (default weekdays 09:15–15:30 Asia/Kolkata), orderType becomes AMO. Returns an ARRAY of response envelopes. Persists the legacy journal used by the legacy holdings endpoint. No automatic retry; a database error after broker submission requires reconciliation.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Required): Positive existing thematic basket ID.
- scrips (Scrip[]; Required): Nonempty; tradingSymbol required. Use version for V1 recommendation tracking.
- source (string; Required): Copies to every submitted scrip, overriding nested source.
- lots (integer; Required in V1): Positive in V1. Legacy stores 1 regardless of submitted lots.
- basketAction (string; Required in V1): BUY or SELL drives inactivation logic; handler checks nonblank, not an enum.
- investmentAmount (number; Optional): Recorded as submitted; not recomputed from prices.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket, Failed

post.description:
Enabled by modules.thematic. Returns the latest version from the rebalance scrip table. weightage, marketCap, version and pdc are null in this response. No order placement.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Supply): Existing basket with rebalance_available = 1 and a prior execution by this user.

Business messages: Rebalance not available for this user or basket., No rebalance data available.

basketId.description: Existing basket with rebalance_available = 1 and a prior execution by this user. Requirement: Supply.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.thematic. Inserts a user execution/view record. Repeated requests insert repeated records. Returns message Basket updated successfully.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Supply): Thematic basket ID; no existence/positivity validation in this handler.
- isViewed (integer; Supply): Use 1 to mark viewed; handler does not constrain values.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter

basketId.description: Thematic basket ID; no existence/positivity validation in this handler. Requirement: Supply.

isViewed.description: Use 1 to mark viewed; handler does not constrain values. Requirement: Supply.

post.description:
Enabled by modules.thematic. Does not place orders. Quantity = stored recommended quantity × lotSize. Prices, total and weights use two-decimal rounding. Returns scrips, totalInvested, investmentAmount, balance "0.00" and configured bufferPercentage. All versions are queried; duplicate tokens across versions cause Failed.

Request fields:
- basketId (integer; Supply): Existing thematic basket.
- lotSize (integer; Supply): Quantity multiplier for review; this is not the lots field. Handler does not enforce positivity.
- scrips (object[]; Required): Nonempty list of token and ltp. Tokens must exist in basket; omitted ltp defaults to zero.

Business messages: Basket not found., Scrip details (LTP) must be provided in request., No scrips found for this basket., Scrip not found in basket: <token>, Failed

No automatic retry; a database error after broker submission requires reconciliation.

- investmentAmount (number; Optional): Recorded as submitted; not recomputed from prices.

Business messages: Invalid Parameter, Invalid basket, Failed, Invalid Parameter basketAction, Invalid Parameter lots

get.description: Enabled by modules.holdings. Returns user basket holdings with scripList and rebalancedAction values Add New, Add More, Reduce, Exit or null. V0 compares current quantities to latest recommended quantities using EXECUTED records. Both preserve EXECUTED-only initial basket discovery/lot calculation; baskets with only complete records can be absent. Empty result is successful.
get.summary: Get thematic holdings and rebalance actions (V0)

get.description: Enabled by modules.holdings. Returns user basket holdings with scripList and rebalancedAction values Add New, Add More, Reduce, Exit or null. V1 compares original recommended quantities to latest recommendations and excludes sold/inactive masters. Aggregation includes EXECUTED/complete records. Both preserve EXECUTED-only initial basket discovery/lot calculation; baskets with only complete records can be absent. Empty result is successful.
get.summary: Get thematic holdings and rebalance actions (V1)

get.description: Enabled by modules.token. Returns escaped HTML with verified username, scopes and refresh_token: false. Does not expose the raw token or create an interactive login session.
Enabled by modules.token. Returns plain text You are logged out. The client must discard its bearer token. This does not revoke provider tokens or implement Quarkus browser-session logout.
